notes.title: No Summer Update
notes.content:
Sorry but there won't be a Summer Update because of retro.

Retro's release is planned to be in November but the summer update which is now going to be a Fall Update has some things of Retro inside it, so I can't release a update with unfinished content sorry!

notes.title: The Summer Update!
notes.content:
The update will of course be in summer, only when in summer? Summer starts on June 1st and ends on August 31st.

I announce that the update will be released on July 15th. After that, the weekly updates begin.
